content.short: STRKFarm is a DeFi yield aggregator on Starknet that automatically invests user assets across DeFi protocols to maximise returns.
content.description: STRKFarm is a DeFi yield aggregator on Starknet that automatically allocates user assets across DeFi protocols within a single strategy to maximize returns. It targets advanced DeFi users who want to earn yield on their tokens. STRKFarm provides two strategies: Autocompounding STRK and Stable Lending Maxi. The Autocompounding strategy reinvests STRK rewards earned during Starknet's DeFi Spring campaign, while Stable Lending Maxi relies on a looping approach to optimize lending yields.
